title: Words and a quiet place for a 3-year-old's distressed
summary: The milestone sheet says to give a 3-year-old words for feelings, and to help with stressful feelings by a deep inhale, a hug of a favorite toy, or a quiet safe place.
body: On the United States milestone sheet for 3-year page, one activity is to chatting about the child's feelings and give words that help the child recount the feelings. Another is to help manage stressful feelings by teaching a deep inhale, hugging a favorite toy, or heading to a quiet safe place when distressed. Those are caregiver practices on an age page. They are not presented as a treatment that replaces a conversation with a doctor when a caregiver is concerned.
